snippet.title: GitNation JavaScript Conferences
snippet.description:
JavaScript is #1 on demand programming language in the world with 25 millions of developers behind it. Meet the ones who shape out the now and the future of the prospering nation.

We are the largest and longest-running #JavaScript community in Benelux, running annual JavaScript conferences JSNation and AmsterdamJS meetups. #jsnation #amsterdamjs

http://jsnation.com
